title: mvg brand file
description: Product-specific brand tokens, truth rules and budgets. Lives in the external media workspace, never in a product repository.

entity.description: The entity this brand's films are made for. Imported narration and stills that name a different entity fail unless an entityException is recorded.

logo.description: Absolute path to the logo lockup (SVG or PNG) drawn on the end card.

safeZones.description: Platform-reserved fractions of the frame height/width per ratio.

forbiddenNames.description: Prospect, customer, partner and competitor names that must never appear in narration, text or frames.

productNames.description: Other written or spoken forms of the product name that count as naming it (for example a two-word public brand, or the form a narrator says).

claimPolicies.description: Industry claim policies this product's factual statements are held to, by name. The generic bans (guarantees, superlatives, testimonials, unsubstantiated comparisons) apply to every product without listing them.

disclosure.description: What every film for this product must disclose. Shared code imposes no industry wording; a product that shows synthetic data lists the words its label must contain.

mustInclude.description: Phrases the film's labels line must contain, compared without case or punctuation.

mode.description: Where the line is shown. Default end-card.

generatedPeople.description: Whether generated people may appear in this product's films. Default any. In a film about the current product they must still be classified as fictional or illustrative.

unlessNegated.description: Allow the phrase when a negation (nothing, not, never, no, without) precedes it in the same sentence.

elevenlabsCredits.description: Cumulative cap across all mvg runs for this brand.

openaiUsd.description: Cumulative cap across all mvg runs for this brand.

assemblyaiUsd.description: Cumulative cap for AssemblyAI. Without a cap (cumulative or per run) new AssemblyAI spend is refused.

deepgramUsd.description: Cumulative cap for Deepgram; same rule.

runwareUsd.description: Cumulative cap for Runware; same rule.

azureUsd.description: Cumulative cap for Azure; same rule.

provider.description: Accepted so existing brand files validate; nothing reads it.

contentLeft.description: Normalized x where the product's left navigation ends in a capture; a crop never starts between 0 and this.
